_about: Public exchange custody accounts on NEAR (hot and cold wallets). Used by R20 so a collector-shaped history is not called a drainer, and by R18 so deposit sweeps are not called hacked wallets. This is not an official exchange list and it is not complete: each user gets their own deposit address, and those are not here.
_limit: Per-user deposit addresses are not listed. A recipient missing from this file can still be an exchange deposit.
